fate_omens.title: Historical Void Auspice
fate_omens.prophecy: The golden coin of luck spins in your favor. An elusive miracle stirs in the historical void; opportunities once deemed lost shall present themselves before twilight.

fate_omens.title: Sunlight Piercing the Fog
fate_omens.prophecy: Purifying light descends upon your path. Spiritual obstacles disperse like morning mist, and allies will respond warmly to your invocations.

fate_omens.title: Whispers of the Spirit World
fate_omens.prophecy: The pendulum swings in erratic spirals. Multiple divergent futures entwine in the fog; avoid hasty commitments and scrutinize the fine print of contracts.

fate_omens.title: Ouroboros Alignment
fate_omens.prophecy: The silver snake bites its tail. A cyclical turn of fate brings recompense for past devotion; expect sudden serendipity in unexpected encounters.

fate_omens.title: Veiled Threshold
fate_omens.prophecy: A closed door stands before your spiritual sight. Knowledge lies beyond, but the cost of the key remains unrevealed. Maintain your anchor.

fate_omens.title: Nocturnal Hallucination
fate_omens.prophecy: Crimson moonlight glimmers with unrest. Taboo whispers seek to breach your spiritual defenses; refrain from reckless divination and guard your thoughts.

fate_omens.title: Distorted Law Reflection
fate_omens.prophecy: The scales of fate lean toward entropy. Beware of subtle deception and legalistic traps in mortal dealings over the coming dawn.

fate_omens.title: Attendant's Blessing
fate_omens.prophecy: The fog parts above the bronze table. Your devotion has resonated with the Ruler of the Mysteries. Good luck shall shield you from sudden calamity.

ritual_events.title: Spirit World Convergence
ritual_events.description: The boundaries between the mortal sanctuary and the Spirit World grow paper-thin. Phantasmal seven-colored lights shimmer above the gathering, vibrating with ancient mystical frequencies.

ritual_events.title: Fog Fluctuation of Sefirah Castle
ritual_events.description: Thick, boundless Grey Fog surges through the sanctuary hall. In the distance, the silhouette of twenty-two majestic high-backed chairs materializes around an ancient mottled bronze table.

ritual_events.title: Crimson Moon Alignment
ritual_events.description: A radiant scarlet halo illuminates the heavens. The nocturnal spirituality of all Beyonders peaks as ancient lunar currents course through the gathering.

ritual_events.title: Astral Tide Resonance
ritual_events.description: A celestial wind blows across the spiritual sea. Ethereal constellations align above the ceiling, granting assembled seekers elevated clarity and heightened intuition.

ritual_events.title: Historical Void Echo
ritual_events.description: A gentle ripple passes through the historical void. Faint projections of ancient Beyonder relics and forgotten incantations brush past the consciousness of the assembly.
